head_coach.name: Ståle Solbakken
head_coach.play_style_summary: Pragmatic northern European style focused on structured zonal defending and highly intense, vertical transition play. Solbakken deploys a fluid 4-3-3 setup that can transition to a 4-4-2 block off-the-ball or a 3-5-2 shape in possession, designed to maximize Ødegaard's playmaking in midfield and Haaland's direct attacking threat in behind the defensive lines.

key_players.name: Erling Haaland
key_players.performance_stats: Staggering 27 goals and 8 assists in 35 Premier League matches during the 2025/26 season for Manchester City. Outstanding shot conversion rate, physical dominance, and clinical finishing. Also scored 16 goals in 8 matches during Norway's World Cup qualification campaign.

key_players.name: Martin Ødegaard
key_players.performance_stats: Recorded 1 goal and 6 assists in 24 Premier League matches during an injury-hampered 2025/26 season with Arsenal. Created 39 chances with an 84.7% pass completion rate, and serves as Norway's captain and primary creative engine.

key_players.name: Alexander Sørloth
key_players.performance_stats: Scored 13 goals with 51% shot accuracy in 35 La Liga matches during the 2025/26 season for Atlético Madrid. Registered a 58.4% aerial duel success rate, demonstrating immense physical target-man presence.
